actual_tool_parameters.prompt:
Create a completely new 2D Japanese anime costume appearance study on white: one close REAR WAIST view with a small matching three-quarter close-up of the DARK dagger's root attachment. Only show the lower orange jacket hem, white undershirt edge, waist, black trouser belt and upper red shorts. NO hands, arms or face. The two whole daggers may extend widely beyond the cropped hips; keep all tips and pommels inside the composition. Clean weighted hand-drawn lines, solid local colors, restrained crisp cel shading. This is a fictional character costume concept, not an engineering drawing. No labels or numbers.

REFERENCE ROLES:
Image 1: clean unarmed Bunny clothing only.
Image 2: exact DARK / IVORY dagger identities and entire shapes; preserve their distinct guards and small hilts.
Image 3: a previous LOCAL study showing the upper collar strap and closed belt ear. Retain ONLY that enclosing upper strap and belt-through layering. Its lower support was missing and must be newly designed as specified below. It is not a reference for the person's sides, steep blade angles, or size.

The crucial new visible part is a very SHORT, THIN charcoal leather THROAT directly BELOW EACH GUARD, wrapping only the first short section of blade root. It has a visible front wall over that short blade root and two returning side walls, with a definite top rim. The guard visibly RESTS ON TOP OF THIS RIM. Below the short throat, the bare blade emerges and its whole long body remains exposed. This small root cover is distinct from both the metal guard above and the belt backing behind. It is not merely a flat pad behind the blade, not a strap across the sharp edge, and not a full-length scabbard. Show a small open side/overlap seam so the wide blade is not required to travel through a tiny closed tube. Keep it visually compact, only near the root.

ABOVE the guard, retain a separate short dark leather cuff around the non-blade red collar, with some red visible. The cuff's front crossing, returning side edge and small dull fastening tab are readable. It returns to the same backing as the short throat. The backing has a closed leather belt ear through which the existing black horizontal trouser belt passes. In the small three-quarter inset, show the whole continuous appearance chain: belt through ear → backing → short lower throat with guard seated ON its rim, plus upper collar cuff. No hidden mechanisms, load diagrams or construction steps. Both blades have their own corresponding compact assembly, not one central holder.

Straight rear view LATERALITY: DARK black angular hilt on screen RIGHT / character RIGHT, blade points shallowly down to screen LEFT. IVORY curved white hilt on screen LEFT / character LEFT, blade points shallowly down to screen RIGHT. Keep a wide SHALLOW X centered around the waistband and upper seat, roughly 25 degrees from horizontal, not a steep X down the legs. White blade passes clearly OUTSIDE the dark one at the crossing with distinct occlusion; neither passes through the body. Both tips extend beyond opposing hip outlines.
Weapons remain large: DARK full length .36 of crown-to-barefoot body height, IVORY .42, ratio6:7. Use reference2's proportions: dark blade roughly two-thirds full length, ivory blade roughly72%; compact one-hand hilts, white clearly longer. Do not shrink blades into the pelvis outline. The inset enlarges the SAME dark attachment, not a new design.

The only wearable base is a black trouser belt through red loops, natural red shorts, orange cropped rear jacket/white hem. Rear center red trouser loop, no rear buckle. No long sheaths, shoulder straps, chest straps, added thigh straps, chains, giant boxes or disk mounts. No photographic or 3D materials, white specks, cloudy smudges or patina. Focus all detail on two visibly seated guards, short lower root covers, upper cuffs and real belt-through loops.

reference_inputs.role: Current clean unarmed Bunny back: clothing and trouser-belt only.
Accepted dagger master-v4: dark/ivory exterior identities; this mounting board does not replace master geometry or dimensions.
Previous v2 local root inset: upper collar wrap and closed belt-ear layering only; missing lower support, incorrect full-view sides/angle/size explicitly excluded by actual prompt.

reference_basis: Actual ordered inputs are clean unarmed body back, accepted dagger master-v4, and a limited v2 local inset. No third-party photograph was passed in this request. The v2 full layout was not accepted.
method: built-in image_gen.imagegen complete-image generation; byte-exact PNG copy and lossless WebP only
limitations: Visible exterior connection study only: not weapon-body components, full-character acceptance, body registration or dimensions.
Master-v4 remains authoritative for weapon shape, fixed total lengths and part ratios; board silhouette/angle are not new geometry targets.
Hidden contact, retention, loading, release action and dynamic clearance have not been validated.
